title: The Woven Mark
description: The (p,q) torus knot painted back-to-front by its own height, so every crossing leaves a gap in the strand beneath; a pen keeps rewriting the knot over its older paint. Exports stills and frames without banding.

changes: First version, on src/render/knot-pen.js. Made for the Myrgic server icon and the animated mark: the live mark's per-frame fade shows as scallops and colour steps when frozen.
Pen depth: keyed at least as high as its own stretch of curve, so its trail cannot paint over the ball; tests/knot-pen.js checks it passes under exactly q*(p-1) crossings per lap.
